History of Science
(journal)
History of Science
is a
peer-reviewed
academic journal
that covers the
history of science
,
medicine
, and
technology
. The
editor-in-chief
is Lissa L. Roberts (
University of Twente
). It was established in 1962 and is published by
SAGE Publications
.
Abstracting and indexing
The journal is abstracted and indexed in
Scopus
and the
Social Sciences Citation Index
. According to the
Journal Citation Reports
, its 2021
impact factor
is 1.0371.
